recommendations.title: Find what fills the data drive and free space with the documented cleanup
recommendations.action: Get the folder size breakdown, free space with the documented cleanup, then confirm the queue starts moving again.
recommendations.rationale: Log says there is not enough free disk space to start a new analysis and the drive is 96% full, which matches a stalled queue with normal CPU and memory.

recommendations.title: Shorten the retention of old analysis results
recommendations.action: Review how long analysis reports are kept and set a retention period that fits the customer's reporting needs.
recommendations.rationale: The customer has kept every report for over a year, up to 14 months old, so space will fill again unless retention is limited.

recommendations.title: Check which unused analysis VM images can be removed
recommendations.action: Identify the unused analysis VM images left from testing and confirm with engineering which are safe to remove.
recommendations.rationale: Several old VM images from earlier testing are still stored; the customer is worried about deleting something Sandbox still needs.
